treatments.evidence: Started on prednisone and mesalamine. Prednisone made me gain 40 pounds in two months. Tapered off prednisone

treatments.reason_stopped: Major flare after six months on mesalamine alone
treatments.evidence: Tried to maintain on mesalamine alone. Lasted six months before major flare

treatments.reason_stopped: Stress-triggered massive flare requiring surgery; superseded by Remicade post-surgery
treatments.evidence: Started methotrexate. The weekly injections became my Friday night ritual. Worked okay for a while.
Started Remicade after surgery. Game-changer initially... But after 18 months, developed antibodies.
Switched to Humira. The every-two-week injection is manageable. Built life around it.

encounters.evidence: Health center said stress, normal for new students

Colonoscopy at 19... Results showed Crohn's throughout colon. Started on prednisone and mesalamine... Started Remicade after surgery... Switched to Humira.
Hospitalized for a week. Started methotrexate.

extraction_notes: Supplements (vitamin D, B12, folate, iron, calcium, probiotic) excluded from treatments as they are nutritional supplements, not IBD-specific drugs. CBT/therapy excluded as non-pharmacological and for comorbid anxiety/PTSD. PCOS and anxiety/PTSD recorded as comorbidities. The college health center visit is included as an encounter but was not on the formal referral path to diagnosis. The hospitalization and surgery are same-admission/closely linked events following the GI relationship already established; surgery marked on_referral_path=false as it did not refer onward independently. Remicade was the first biologic (post-surgery), making the GI specialist encounter the biologic_decision_point. Humira is the current biologic; Remicade was prior. No barriers to biologic use stated — patient is currently on Humira with good insurance.
